title: Evaluation of Explanation Methods of AI - CNNs in Image Classification Tasks with Reference-based and No-reference Metrics
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation and comparison of explanation methods for CNNs in image classification tasks using reference-based and no-reference metrics. It does not address religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, hermeneutics, morals, or ethics as a central component of its evaluation or benchmarking.
